name: HADDOCK3, docking guided by ambiguous interaction restraints

restraints._note: ambig.tbl is GENERATED from sites.*.fallback_residues or from contacts derived from the reference complex, instead of being written by hand per target.

score._note: This is not kcal/mol and is not comparable with the Vina score. Never rank the two in the same table.

notes: Docking guided by ambiguous interaction restraints (AIR). Useful when the site is not an enclosed cavity that Vina resolves well: a protomer junction in a filament, a dimer interface, or a site defined by known catalytic residues rather than by a co-crystal.
